note: Digital anomalies including 2-3 toe syndactyly and 5th finger clinodactyly are recurrently documented in Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome cohorts.

evidence.text: In a 24-patient cohort with Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome caused by PSMD12 haploinsufficiency, 5 individuals presented with 2 to 3 toe syndactyly, alongside preaxial hand abnormalities.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: Of note, 5 individuals also showed 2 to 3 toe syndactyly.

evidence.text: Microdeletions encompassing PSMD12 lead to a recognizable phenotype including fifth finger clinodactyly, tapered digits, and 2/3 toe syndactyly.

source.title: Association of 17q24. 2‐q24. 3 deletions with recognizable phenotype and short telomeres
source.quote: large sandal gaps, tapered digits and fifth finger clinodactyly. … Nevertheless, some symptoms such as 2/3 toe syndactyly
